summary: Meds Apotek AB operates as an online pharmacy that sells prescription and non-prescription medicines in Sweden. The company offers various products, including beauty products, dietary supplements, children's products, facial care, vitamins and supplements, oral care for animals, pet accessories, fur care, allergy medicine, sunscreen and body sunscreen, eye mask, sleep mask, earplugs, hearing aids, contact lenses, fitness products, electric toothbrush, heat tools for hair, food and drinks, and home & household products. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Hägersten, Sweden.
